name: hera
description: Hera is a self-hosted music recommendation and music discovery service with automated downloading powered by Last.fm and Downtify. Discover new music tailored to your listening taste, fetch recommendations on a schedule, and keep your self-hosted music library fresh.

paths.name: Music Downloads Directory
paths.description: Directory where downloaded audio files are stored (must match Downtify's download folder)

paths.name: App Configuration
paths.description: Persistent directory for Hera settings and history

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: HTTP port for the Hera Web UI

variables.name: Downtify API URL
variables.description: URL to the Downtify backend container

variables.name: Last.fm API Key
variables.description: Your Last.fm API Key (can also be entered in the WebUI)

variables.name: Last.fm Username
variables.description: Your Last.fm Username (can also be entered in the WebUI)

variables.name: Cron Schedule
variables.description: Cron expression for automated nightly download pipeline
